## Chapter purpose

Extend classical methods using flexible tools for data that are small, irregular, incomplete, highly predictive, or dependent over time.

## Topics

::: {.statx-topic-grid}
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>7.1–7.2</span>
### Distribution-light methods
Nonparametric comparisons and bootstrap uncertainty.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>7.3</span>
### Cross-validation
Estimate how well a model generalizes beyond its training data.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>7.4</span>
### Missing data
Recognize missingness mechanisms and the risks of incomplete-case analysis.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>7.5–7.6</span>
### Bayesian and time-dependent reasoning
Introduce Bayesian updating and the special structure of time series.
:::
